method: Retrospective independent set frozen without inspecting ranker output. Open public items disjoint from tracked past audits and both Mission 4 sets. Four positive technical checks require a relevant implementation or real test range, including two embedded SPIR-V fixtures. A reference with only the exact VUID and no corresponding operation or actual test does not satisfy these labels. Countdown, timing terms, related allocations or graphics code without a decision are insufficient. One scoped noise control checks behavior on a general timing symptom. This evaluates source applicability as a check, not implementation transfer or adoption.

cases.title: 64-bit subgroup operations do not work, despite shaderSubgroupExtendedTypes being advertised
cases.mechanism: The MoltenVK report asks whether advertised subgroup extended types imply that 64-bit integer subgroup arithmetic can run.
cases.decision: Check shaderInt64 and shaderSubgroupExtendedTypes separately. The independently implemented Vulkan CTS gates 64-bit subgroup arithmetic on both claims. It is an applicability check for the reported device, not proof of a backend fix.

sources.note: Exact TYPE_INT64 and TYPE_UINT64 condition in the shared CTS format gate.

cases.title: Vulkan validation errors on examples (Invalid explicit layout decorations on type for operand...)
cases.mechanism: wgpu reports the validator rejecting a shader-local Function variable with explicit structure layout decorations.
cases.decision: Compare the emitted SPIR-V storage class and decorations with the independent Function block fixture. Check SPIR-V version and whether the Block decoration belongs only on the interface copy. A similarly numbered Private fixture is a negative distractor.

sources.note: Current test uses embedded shader assembly and checks the exact VUID on a Function block.
The same independent validator fixture before it was moved.

cases.title: Some CTS tests cause vulkan validation errors
cases.mechanism: One still-open item of the wgpu CTS tracker concerns a textureNumLayers lowering that triggers the SPIR-V image size-with-LOD diagnostic.
cases.decision: Use the external validator fixture to test whether the emitted OpImageQuerySizeLod operand really has Sampled = 1. Review a no-LOD or separate path only after distinguishing image kind. The unrelated VUIDs in the same tracking issue do not qualify.

sources.note: The embedded shader gives a storage-image operand and expects the exact Vulkan diagnostic.

cases.title: Do we need a barrier prior to buffer mapping?
cases.mechanism: wgpu wants an independent answer about additional synchronization before CPU reads a device-written mapped buffer.
cases.decision: For Vulkan, compare the external CTS readback operation, which explicitly adds a transfer-write to host-read barrier after the copy. Check ordering and host visibility separately and measure whether a separate submission is needed. D3D12 and Metal still need independent contracts.

sources.note: The Vulkan CTS GPU copy and host visibility control provide a concrete test pattern.

cases.title: Apple M1 Max MoltenVK CPU performance is slow
cases.mechanism: The MoltenVK issue compares vkQueueSubmit timing on unrelated platforms and reports no Vulkan validity diagnostic.
cases.decision: Repeat on an apples-to-apples workload or collect per-stage timing before suggesting a fix. Shared submission, driver or fence terms do not explain the timing contrast.
